content:
billing-bot: [ALERT] Metering pipeline anomaly detected: token_count_delta > 15% vs baseline for service=aggregator-prod-eu in last 10m. overflag_count=5. origin=ingest-collector, pipeline=usage-emit, signal_type=delayed_emit
Emerson: Paging SRE oncall — token counts diverging from shadow ledger, overage alerts firing. @Alex (oncall) ? :pager:
Priya: Looking at dashboards now. Kafka consumer group `usage-consumer-eu-1` lag jumped ~120k messages at 02:12 UTC. No recent deploys flagged by deploy-bot.
Marco: Any recent config changes to windowing or commit behaviour? Last aggregator rollout was yesterday to v1.4.2 but no hotfixes since.
Jamie: Logs show repeated commit timeouts from the consumer: 
```
2026-03-20T02:12:34Z consumer-eu1 ERROR OffsetCommitException: Commit failed (Timeout) groupId=usage-eu
2026-03-20T02:12:35Z consumer-eu1 WARN Rebalance in progress, delaying commit
```
Alex (oncall): I'm taking it. Will attempt a consumer restart and offset rewind. Also: which customers saw overage flags? Need to coordinate CS.
Priya: Top customers with alerts: cust-42, cust-88, cust-bankX, cust-guest, cust-DX. Alerts look noisy: billing totals are lower than shadow ledger, which suggests missing emits -> undercount at billing but thresholds triggering because shadow/threshold alignment is stale.
Emerson: To confirm: shadow_ledger > billing_aggregator in recent window, so it's missing emits from collector -> billing shows less tokens but overage flags are from a different heuristic? Could be stale thresholding on the alerting side.
Marco: Proposed immediate mitigations: (1) mute `billing.overflag.alerts.eu` for 30m to avoid customer churn, (2) restart consumer group `usage-consumer-eu-1`, (3) apply patch to aggregator to increase commit retries and log backpressure metrics.
Jamie: Hotfix ready: set `consumer.commit.retries=5` and `kafka.max.poll.interval.ms=600000` in aggregator config. I can push a canary to one instance now.
Alex (oncall): Do the canary. I'll mute the alerting rule and post to status page: "Investigating delayed ingest causing billing anomalies in EU; customer alerts muted temporarily." Notifying CS to hold outbound messages.
Emerson: Muting alert rule now. @Priya please run a quick reconciliation against the shadow ledger for the last 3 hours and post checksums. Also add a note about which billing run windows are affected.
Priya: Reconciliation snapshot:
shadow_sum=1,243,210 tokens
billing_sum=1,198,112 tokens
delta=45,098 (~3.6%)
Window start=2026-03-20T00:00Z window end=2026-03-20T03:00Z
This aligns with the consumer lag spike at 02:12 UTC.
Marco: If the canary reduces lag within 10m, roll full patch. If not, consider failing over consumer partitions to a healthy consumer pool and plan a backfill from the collector topic.
Alex (oncall): Can you also confirm whether any commit offsets were lost and whether we need to replay messages? If replay needed, CS impact will be longer. I'll keep the oncall rotation updated; handoff if >1h.
Jamie: Canary applied to instance i-agg-eu-03. Observing commit success rates improving, lag decreasing to ~12k. Metrics: commit_success_rate went from 40% -> 92% after increased retries.
Priya: Re-run checksum at 02:35 UTC after partial catch-up: shadow_sum=1,243,998 billing_sum=1,243,021 delta=977 (~0.08%) — looks like backfill in progress and narrowing.
Emerson: Good. Keep overflag mute until we confirm full reconciliation and stable commits for 30m. I'll own postmortem and impact notes.
billing-bot: Incident note appended: incident_id=INC-2026-1742223333 severity=sev2 cust_impact=5 mitigations=[alert-mute,restart-consumer,canary-patch]
Alex (oncall): Status page updated. CS informed with list of affected customers; holding all outbound notices until we confirm final reconciliation. Handoff: if this persists past 03:30 UTC escalate to SRE Lead.
Emerson: Thanks all — short replies please. I'll schedule the RCA and include timeline, root cause hypothesis (consumer commit timeouts causing delayed emits -> billing undercount + stale alert thresholds) and remediation steps (increase retries, alert tuning, auto-muted rule on spike).
(reacts :thumbsup:)
